benefits.titleEn: Talk about getting back something that was lost
benefits.zh: win back 可以表示重新取得信任、支持、顧客、信心或隊中的位置。
benefits.en: Win back can describe regaining trust, support, customers, confidence or a place in a team.

benefits.titleZh: 自然地談論說服別人改變看法
benefits.titleEn: Talk naturally about changing someone’s mind
benefits.zh: win somebody over 和 win somebody round 可以表示成功說服某人接受或支持一個想法。
benefits.en: Win somebody over and win somebody round can show that someone has been persuaded to accept or support an idea.

benefits.zh: win out 可以表示某個計劃、想法或力量最終勝過另一方。
benefits.en: Win out can show that one plan, idea or force finally becomes stronger than another.

benefits.titleZh: 描述經歷困難後取得成功
benefits.titleEn: Describe success after a difficult time
benefits.zh: win through 可以表示某人、家庭、球隊或機構面對嚴重問題後，最終仍然成功。
benefits.en: Win through can show that a person, family, team or organisation finally succeeds despite serious problems.
